findings.source: HoneyFactory_V0.sol:357-362 for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredAssets.length; i++) { ...; honeyToMint += _mint(registeredAssets[i], amount, receiver, true); }
findings.issue: P3: the basket-mode loop is rotated; its printed condition is the overflow check of 'honeyToMint +=' (d <= b + d), the real bound i < registeredAssets.length is an early return inside the body, and the loop's normal exit is the Panic(17) after it.
findings.rule: Choose as loop condition the test that leads to the loop's ordinary exit (here the bound, whose exit returns), not a check whose failure reverts; keep 'require b + d >= d' inside the body.

findings.source: SafeTransferLib.safeTransferFrom: if iszero(and(eq(mload(0x00), 1), success)) { if iszero(lt(or(iszero(extcodesize(token)), returndatasize()), success)) { revert } }
findings.issue: The bit-trick success test is printed literally; it means 'revert unless (code exists and returndata is empty) and the call succeeded'.
findings.rule: For booleans s and an integer r: 'not (or(not c, r) < s)' is 'not s or not c or r != 0'; print it as such.

notes: mint and redeem (1,200 and 1,000 pack lines) reviewed by structure. Source loops (10): isBasketModeEnabled :534, mint :357 (rotated, finding), redeem :393 and :412, setGlobalCap :203, withdrawAllFees :247, _getWeights :673 and :689, _isCappedGlobal :714, _lookupRegistrationIndex :293 ('while True' searches) - all while, inlined several times (_getWeights in 7 places). FixedPointMathLib.fullMulDiv's Yul 'for {} 1 {}' and the ERC4626 code belong to CollateralVault_V0, reached only by external calls (vaults[x].convertToAssets), so not counted. Implicit loops: the uint256[] return encodings of getWeights as word-copy whiles (P7, 'while s < mem[128]: mem[t] = mem[u]'), checked-exp loops 'while u > 1'. Many 'mem[0] = 3' dead writes before mapping reads (P8), implied Panic(50) checks of weights[i] (P11). No semantic error found.
summary: Complete and faithful; all source loops are while loops, but mint's basket loop is rotated around an overflow check, and the inlined _getWeights loops and raw-memory call arguments make mint/redeem long and obscure.
